sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "artists" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_lower" TEXT NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS (LOWER("name")) STORED UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "albums" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "name_lower" TEXT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS (LOWER("name")) STORED, "artist_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES artists (id), "year" INTEGER NULL, "is_single_grouping" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_single_grouping" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tracks" ("uuid_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_updated" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NULL, "downloaded_bitrate_kbps" INTEGER NULL, "file_size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "downloaded_quality" TEXT NULL, "downloaded_at_revision" INTEGER NULL, "downloaded_codec" TEXT NULL, "stale_dismissed_at_revision" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trackmetadata" ("uuid_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (uuid_id), "title" TEXT NULL, "artist" TEXT NULL, "album" TEXT NULL, "album_artist" TEXT NULL, "artist_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES artists (id), "album_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES albums (id), "year" INTEGER NULL, "date" TEXT NULL, "genre" TEXT NULL, "track_number" INTEGER NULL, "disc_number" INTEGER NULL, "codec" TEXT NULL, "duration" REAL NULL, "bitrate_kbps" REAL NULL, "sample_rate_hz" INTEGER NULL, "channels" INTEGER NULL, "has_album_art" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_album_art" IN (0, 1)), "cover_art_id" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "queue_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_artist_id" INTEGER NULL, "source_album_id" INTEGER NULL, "current_item_id" INTEGER NULL, "resume_main_item_id" INTEGER NULL, "current_position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "repeat_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'off', "shuffle_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("shuffle_enabled" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "queue_session_items" ("item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES queue_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "queue_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'main', "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "uuid_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (uuid_id), UNIQUE(session_id, queue_type, position));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "queue_session_play_order" ("session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES queue_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "play_position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES queue_session_items (item_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id", "play_position"), UNIQUE(session_id, item_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_edits" ("uuid_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "values_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "write_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_revision" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "server_revision" INTEGER NULL, "original_values_json" TEXT NULL, "rejection_reason" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "server_binding" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("id" = 1), "instance_id" TEXT NULL, "local_binding_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_base_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "bound_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "catalog_reconciled_at_binding" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("catalog_reconciled_at_binding" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("stream" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("stream"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "history_events" ("local_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "event_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "seconds_played" REAL NULL, "track_length" REAL NULL, "server_revision" INTEGER NULL UNIQUE, "received_at" INTEGER NULL, "pending_upload" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("pending_upload" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_counters" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "history_sync_failures" ("event_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "detail" TEXT NULL, "failed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "history_conflict_archive" ("archive_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "event_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "active_listens" ("listen_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "queue_session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "queue_item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "track_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_seconds" REAL NULL, "accumulated_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_checkpoint_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("state" IN ('accumulating', 'finalizing')), "final_payload_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("listen_uuid"));
